other_conditions: Must be a native of Rajasthan.
Must be enrolled in a school, college or university recognized by the state government.
Must be a girl student pursuing senior secondary (agriculture subjects in 11th/12th), agricultural graduate education, postgraduate agriculture, or a PhD in agriculture.
Must not have failed in the last year.
Incentive is not payable if the student leaves the institution in the middle of the class session.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹40,000 per annum depending on the level of agricultural education (senior secondary, graduate, postgraduate, or PhD).
